summary_1line: Kunti, fearing Surya’s curse and social shame, consents to him; he grants a son with divine armor and earrings while preserving her virginity.

image_candidates.scene_text: The radiant sun-god Surya touches Kunti’s navel with blazing light as she collapses faint upon her bed.
Kunti, trembling and bashful, stands before the blazing figure of Surya who fills the chamber with golden rays.
A stunned Kunti lies like a broken creeper on her couch while the luminous form of Surya withdraws skyward.
